run_finetune_model: run the finetuning script to train a sequence classification model on unperturbed and perturbed datasets
run_fairscore_evaluation: run the fairscore evaluation on a pretrained model using perturbed and unperturbed evaluation datasets
run_load_datasets_and_collator: run load_datasets_and_collator to load train, unperturbed eval, and perturbed eval datasets with a data collator
run_compute_metrics: run compute_metrics to calculate accuracy and other metrics from model predictions and labels
run_compute_fairscore: run compute_fairscore to compute fairness metrics comparing model performance on perturbed versus unperturbed examples
